# Four Dogs Entertainment
Four Dogs Entertainment creates trivia, Music Bingo, DJ entertainment, interactive game nights, weddings, karaoke, private events, corporate entertainment, and venue programming in Lexington, Columbia, Cayce, West Columbia, and the South Carolina Midlands.
Official event information: https://4dogsentertainment.com/events/
Services: https://4dogsentertainment.com/services/
Booking: https://4dogsentertainment.com/booking/

West Columbia and Cayce entertainment: https://4dogsentertainment.com/areas/west-columbia-cayce-sc/

Music Bingo in Columbia: https://4dogsentertainment.com/music-bingo-columbia-sc/
Recurring schedule: Tuesdays at 6:30 PM at Top Dawg Tavern in Columbia; Tuesdays at 6:30 PM at WesCo Brew & Bowl in Cayce beginning September 8, 2026; Wednesdays at 7:30 PM at Boze's Restaurant & Bar in West Columbia; Wednesdays and Thursdays at 6:30 PM at Charter 803 Bar & Grill in Lexington. The Events page is the authoritative source for dates, themes, and schedule changes.
Four Dogs Survey Showdown is a Four Dogs survey-style competition and is not affiliated with Family Feud. Are You Smarter Than a Barstool? is a Four Dogs original parody experience and is not affiliated with Are You Smarter Than a 5th Grader?
